_comment: THE REAL SYSTEM. Captured by `energycap discover` against the live Carrier cloud on
2026-08-17 (data/discover-raw.json, gitignored) and trimmed to the fields our query
requests; the serial appeared only in the request variables and is not reproduced here,
so nothing in this file identifies the house beyond one afternoon of weather.
It settles PLAN.md 7.3's open question and DEVIATIONS.md #75.1: this outdoor unit is
`gs3ngiphp` - Greenspeed, i.e. VARIABLE CAPACITY - and `odu.opstat` is the string "35",
a 0-100 compressor capacity percentage, not one of the words STAGE_CODES encodes.
So this payload must emit `stage_pct` = 35.0 (unit pct, channel `system`) and NO `stage`
row, while `idu.opstat` is the word "off" - proof that the two units disagree in shape
and that STAGE_SOURCE = odu is what decides which one is read.
Eight zones are reported and only zone 1 is installed; the seven phantoms carry a
plausible rh/htsp/clsp and are trimmed to two here (one enabled, one phantom) - the
full-phantom case is pinned by status_single_zone.json. `name` and `vent` arrive as
JSON null rather than the string "None" on this system: both spellings are real.
